5-fold cross-validation of the 5000 HES PLCs

Source: /zfs/d4/HES/PLASHES5K_final
Each name is a base complex {index}.{pdbid}.

Each fold evaluates on 1000 complexes and trains on the other 4000.

Lists: retrain/cv_5k/fold{k}_val_plcs.txt and fold{k}_train_plcs.txt.
Below, each fold lists the complexes in its evaluation set.
Its training set is every complex in this file that is not in that list.
